_comment: Lets the Firebase CLI find the rules beside it, so the deploy commands in
the comments at the top of each .rules file work from this directory:
and so `Scripts/run-rules-checks.sh` can start the emulators and evaluate
the rules with Firebase's own engine rather than a transcription of them.
The emulators need no project of their own: the checks run under a project
id beginning with `demo-`, which the CLI treats as offline-only and never
Ports are deliberately not the defaults. The defaults collide with the PHP
preview server and the CDP port the browser harnesses use, and a check
that fails because something else answered is worse than no check.
